headline: ARGMAX VERDICT (threshold-free, the robust result): s IS the top-scoring radius-1 ball at depol 0.045/0.06/0.08 and FAILS at 0.10. So the ball decoder recovers s at the deepest in-regime dose (0.06, R=6.7e-4) where raw-modal margin is only 1.23x -> VERIFIES Whisper proposal; and it EXTENDS past raw-modal, which already fails at 0.08 (s not the mode, peak 34) yet ball argmax=s. Transition: works to R~1.7e-4, fails at R~8.5e-5.
null_model_caveat: CRITICAL (advisor): the T_ball=124 own-null was computed on UNIFORM multinomial (17 indep Poisson(3.05) bins, mean 52). But at depol 0.10 the observed ball_max=234 at HD-4 is ~25sigma above that mean — IMPOSSIBLE for independent bins. The real competing background is STRUCTURED/correlated (readout error correlates Hamming-neighbor bins — the same effect the ball exploits for signal inflates background balls — plus a coherent-residual competitor). So the operative null is >=~234, NOT 124. The uniform T_ball is OPTIMISTIC; quote margins against ~234.
failure_characterization: At depol 0.10 (R=8.5e-5) the ball decoder mis-decodes to a Hamming-distance-4 impostor (ball_max 234 > ball@s 198) — NOT diffuse noise but a STRUCTURED coherent wrong-answer the noisy HSS circuit favors as R->0. Open item (needs retained count arrays, not a reflight): is that impostor bin already elevated at 0.06/0.08 (stable coherent competitor) or only at 0.10 (fluke)?
perbit_verdict: Per-bit marginal decoder WASHES OUT at R<=6.7e-4 (min-z ~0.02-0.27 = CHANCE-LEVEL; the is_s=True at 0.06 is a coin-flip that landed right, NOT a detection). Works only at high R (0.045, z4.97). The ball decoder is the right statistic; per-bit is the wrong tool in-regime.
pre_reg_todo: The fresh HSS pre-reg must calibrate the ball decoders null on a REALISTIC background (readout-correlation + coherent residual), NOT uniform multinomial. Threshold != decoder validity. n=16 is the simulable proxy; the numeric boundary does not auto-transfer to n=40 (sparser background there likely helps the ball).
